01 / CARBON DETAIL

CLEAN

Signature Hand Wash

from AED 150

An attentive exterior wash that lifts everyday dust and road grime, with care for the finish beneath.

What’s included

  • ↗Gentle pre-wash and hand wash
  • ↗Wheel faces and tyres cleaned
  • ↗Careful microfibre drying
  • ↗Exterior glass and finishing touches
Our process & the right fit +

The process

We begin with a rinse and pre-wash, clean the wheels separately, then hand wash and dry with clean microfibre towels.

Is this for your car?

For regular exterior care and a clean, well-kept finish.

02 / CARBON DETAIL

RESET

Interior Deep Cleaning

from AED 450

A deeper reset for the space you spend time in. Thoughtful cleaning of upholstery, touchpoints and the details between.

What’s included

  • ↗Seats, carpets and mats vacuumed
  • ↗Upholstery cleaned to suit its material
  • ↗Dashboard, console and crevices detailed
  • ↗Interior glass cleaned
Our process & the right fit +

The process

After inspecting the materials, we vacuum, brush and clean each area using a suitable method, then check the cabin before handover.

Is this for your car?

For built-up dust, everyday marks and a more considered interior clean. Stain removal depends on the material and condition.

03 / CARBON DETAIL

REFINE

Paint Correction

from AED 900

Careful machine polishing to reduce visible light swirls and bring more depth and clarity to the finish.

What’s included

  • ↗Wash and paint decontamination
  • ↗Paint inspection and test area
  • ↗Machine polishing suited to the finish
  • ↗Final inspection and finishing wipe
Our process & the right fit +

The process

We inspect the paint, prepare the surface and test a small area before choosing a polishing approach. The aim is an improved finish with sensible paint preservation.

Is this for your car?

For light swirl marks and dullness. Deep scratches and damaged clear coat may require a different repair.

Book this service

Final scope and pricing depend on the vehicle and its condition. Discuss details before booking.

04 / CARBON DETAIL

PROTECT

Ceramic Coating

from AED 1,500

A carefully prepared protective layer that helps make routine washing easier and brings out the character of your paint.

What’s included

  • ↗Thorough wash and decontamination
  • ↗Surface assessment and preparation
  • ↗Ceramic coating application
  • ↗Curing guidance and aftercare advice
Our process & the right fit +

The process

Clean, prepared paint comes first. We apply the coating methodically, level it panel by panel, then explain the curing and maintenance steps.

Is this for your car?

For drivers looking for easier ongoing care. Paint correction, if needed, is discussed separately; coating does not prevent scratches or stone chips.
